Application Modules¶

Accounts¶

Define the custom user model for the news application.

class accounts.models.User(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Represent a user and their role within the news application.

Users can be readers, journalists or editors. Readers can subscribe to Publishers and Journalists. Journalists can be associated with a publisher.

exception DoesNotExist¶
exception MultipleObjectsReturned¶
exception NotUpdated¶

Provide views for user registration and authentication.

HttpResponse

News¶

Define the models used by the news application.

class news.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Represent a news article and its publication status.

An article has an author, content, a creation date and an approval status. It must be associated with either a journalist or a publisher, but not both.

exception DoesNotExist¶
exception MultipleObjectsReturned¶
exception NotUpdated¶
clean()[source]¶

Validate the article’s journalist and publisher.

Ensure that an article is associated with exactly one of a journalist or a publisher.

Raises:

ValidationError – If both relationships are set or if neither relationship is set.

class news.models.Newsletter(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Represent a curated collection of news articles.

A newsletter has a title, description, author and a collection of articles.

exception DoesNotExist¶
exception MultipleObjectsReturned¶
exception NotUpdated¶
class news.models.Publisher(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Represents a news publisher.

A publisher has a name and a description and can be associated with multiple news articles.

exception DoesNotExist¶
exception MultipleObjectsReturned¶

Provide views for the news application.

news.views.api_approve_article(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Approve an article through the REST API.

Verify that the request is authenticated and made by an editor, then mark the selected article as approved.

Parameters:

request (Request) – The API request received by the endpoint.

Returns:

A response containing the approval result or an error.

Return type:

Response

news.views.api_article_detail(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Retrieve, update, or delete an article through the REST API.

GET requests retrieve approved articles. Authenticated and authorized users can update or delete articles.

Parameters:

  • request (Request) – The API request received by the endpoint.

  • article_id (int) – The ID of the article to access.

Returns:

A response containing article data, a status or an error.

Return type:

Response

news.views.api_article_list(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

List approved articles or create an article through the API.

Return approved articles for GET requests. Authenticated journalists can submit new articles through POST requests.

Parameters:

request (Request) – The API request received by the endpoint.

Returns:

A REST framework response containing data or errors.

Return type:

Response

news.views.api_subscribed_articles(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Return approved articles from a reader’s subscriptions.

Retrieve approved articles from subscribed publishers and journalists and return them as serialized data.

Parameters:

request (Request) – The API request received by the endpoint.

Returns:

A response containing articles or an error.

Return type:

Response

Approve an article and notify subscribed readers.

Allow editors to approve an article and email readers subscribed to its publisher or independent journalist.

HttpResponse

HttpResponse
